body:
hexagon: matmul and flash-atten scalability updates ( #29974 )

- hexagon: head-parallel flash_attn partitioning for row-split multicore

In row-split mode each core computes its output row shard of every

MUL_MAT, but flash_attn was previously partitioning by Q tokens

(flat qrow split) instead of by heads. This forced every core to

read the full KV cache (all n_kv_heads), negating the memory

bandwidth benefit of multicore on flash_attn.

Change both HMX and HVX flash_attn kernels to partition by KV heads

when n_kv_heads is divisible by n_cores: core i processes heads

[i*n_kv_heads/N, (i+1)*n_kv_heads/N) exclusively, reading only its

head shard of the KV cache. Falls back to the original token-block

split when n_kv_heads % n_cores != 0 (e.g. Gemma-4 with 2 KV heads

Controlled by GGML_HEXAGON_FA_HEAD_SPLIT (default 1 = on).

The flag is packed into bit 1 of the existing is_dst_fp32 kparams

byte to stay within the 128-byte kernel_params blob limit.

Measured gains at 4c row-split (PP t/s, ubatch=1024):

Qwen3-0.6B: 6977 -> 11026 (+58%)

llama-3.2-3B: 3717 -> 5522 (+49%)

Qwen3.5-4B: 2739 -> 2855 (+4%)

Gemma-4 MoE: no change (MoE FFN dominates, fallback path)

TG is unchanged (flash_attn is a small fraction of decode time

relative to the matmul+barrier cost per layer).

summaryZh: Llama.cpp 发布了针对高通 Hexagon 架构的重大更新（#29974），引入了行拆分多核场景下的头并行 flash_attn 分区策略。通过在 KV 头能被核心数整除时将任务按头划分，避免了重复读取整个 KV 缓存，大幅提升了内存带宽利用率。实测在 4 核 row-split 模式下，Qwen3-0.6B 预填充速度提升达 58%，Llama-3.2-3B 提升 49%，同时对内核参数和多设备场景下的矩阵乘法分配进行了全面清理和改进。
